newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian forces fire at Pakistani plane - agency.
newsitem.headline: Indian forces fire at Pakistani plane - agency.

text.p: The Indian Air Force fired at a pilotless Pakistani aircraft on Wednesday after it crossed into Indian air space over the western state of Gujarat, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said. It did not say if the plane was hit, but quoted a defence spokesman as saying the shooting took place over Bhuj airport, 300 km (190 miles) from the state capital of Ahmedabad.

The air force's southwestern command had reported some intrusions into Indian airspace in the neighbourhood of Bhuj and Nalia, adjoining the western border, in the last few days, PTI quoted the spokesman as saying.

"These intrusions were made by small pilotless and remote controlled aircraft, originating on the Pakistan side of the border. One such aircraft was sighted near Bhuj airport this morning and was fired at by the Indian Air Force," he said.
Defence officials could not be reached for their comment.
